column2: I would do anything for my family, but it is hard work to foster loyalty and devotion, not only towards me but among all the quarrelsome members of our great House. When I am gone, the harmony I leave behind will be my greatest legacy.
Hear me roar!

House [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] stands firm on the rock of its proud [Root.GetPatriarchMatriarch], [Root.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal]! Cousins who would not share a table now share a cup, and the young ones come to me before they go to anyone else.

Clan [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] stands firm on the rock of its proud [Root.GetPatriarchMatriarch], [Root.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal]! Grudges between cousins that festered for a century have been struck from the clan book, and the beardlings learn the names of their ancestors at my knee.
I shall be genial and well liked.
I shall master the game of life.
No, I seek another lifestyle.
I have been spending more time with my [target_spouse.GetHusbandWife] [target_spouse.GetFirstName] lately, and though of course we did not marry for love, I can tell it is growing between us.

I have been spending more time with my [target_spouse.GetHusbandWife] [target_spouse.GetFirstName] lately. Our marriage was a contract between clans, weighed in gold and oaths like any other, but there is something more between us now, solid as good stone.
Ah, marital bliss!

I have been making an effort to spend more time with my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]. We have not always seen eye to eye, but as [From.GetPossPronoun] liege it is all the more important that I win [From.GetPossPronoun] loyalty and respect.
I have been writing regularly to my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName], and I make sure to see [From.GetObjectPronoun] whenever I can. It is a harsh world, and kin must stand together against it.
My little [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] adores me, and I love playing with [From.GetObjectPronoun]. It is good to lay the groundwork for the years ahead...
Family first!
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName], the [GetRootFromCompliment] [From.GetManWoman], can always count on me. I help wherever and however I can, out of respect, if not always love.

It is hard to find the time, but whenever I can I spend some of it with my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]. [From.GetSubjectPronounCap] must learn how much family matters, and to honour and love [From.GetPossPronoun] parents!

I have been writing regularly to my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName], and I make sure to see [From.GetObjectPronoun] whenever I can, to give sage advice and remind [From.GetObjectPronoun] of [From.GetPossPronoun] duties.
As a reigning [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle] I rarely have a moment to spare, but for my little [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] I would move mountains!

I have noticed that [target_first.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] and [target_second.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] are not on the best of terms, and I mean to put that right! I have invited them both to [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName] for some time together as a family.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has invited me to [From.Capital.Capital.GetName] for some time with the family. I am sure the idea is for me to make friends with [target_second.GetTitledName].
That sounds nice!
What idiocy! I think not.

My [GetFromFromRelation] [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has invited me to [FromFrom.Capital.Capital.GetName] for some time with the family. I am sure the idea is for me to make friends with [From.GetTitledName]...
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has refused my invitation. There will be no reconciliation with [target_second.GetTitledName].
How foolish!
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has refused my invitation. There will be no reconciliation with [target_first.GetTitledName].

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] refused [target_initiator.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal]'s invitation for us all to spend some time together in [target_initiator.Capital.Capital.GetName]...
How silly of [From.GetObjectPronoun]!
[From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal], [target_initiator.GetFirstName] and I had a wonderful time together! I feel our family bonds are stronger for it.
We should do it again some time.
[From.GetFirstName], [FromFrom.GetFirstName] and I had the best of times together! I am sure they like each other better now.

Constant fights and vicious pranks: my two children [target_second.GetFirstName] and [target_first.GetFirstName] never seemed able to get along, but my efforts to teach them love and respect have finally borne fruit. Their friendship will serve them well when I am gone...

Pulled beards, broken toy axes and a grudge sworn over a stolen honeycake: my two children [target_second.GetFirstName] and [target_first.GetFirstName] never seemed able to get along. But I have made them strike that grudge from their little book together, and their friendship will serve the clan well when I have gone to the Halls of the Ancestors.
Who can you trust, if not your siblings?
